dimensions.assessment: Affects Indian tribes, Alaska Native corporations, the Department of the Interior, and the Department of Agriculture.
dimensions.evidence: land that is in the State of Alaska and held by an Alaska Native Corporation

dimensions.assessment: Significantly expands project eligibility rules and permits direct land management actions on tribal and expanded federal/native lands.
dimensions.evidence: allows TFPA projects to be carried out directly on Indian forest lands and rangelands.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this Act $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031.

dimensions.assessment: Amends existing land management statutes to alter geographical criteria, entity eligibility, and project locations.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Tribal Forest Protection Act of 2004 to improve that Act

dimensions.assessment: Provides multi-year spending authorization and permanent statutory program amendments through FY2031.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031.

missing_information: Actual number of tribes or acres of land that will participate or be treated under the expanded authorities.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill reauthorizes the Tribal Forest Protection Act through FY2031 at $15 million annually, expands eligible lands to include Alaska Native Corporation lands, permits work directly on tribal lands, and broadened geographic criteria.
